configure.title: Igama Lesikali
configure.description: Isilinganiso sobubanzi:ukuphakama beshadi (Bheka https://gionkunz.github.io/chartist-js/getting-started.html#default-sass-settings ukuthola u-$ct-scales no-$ct-scales-names).

configure.title: Isamba
configure.description: Isamba esingaphoqelekile ongasicacisa. Ngokucacisa inani lesamba, isamba samanani ochungechungeni kufanele sibe yilesi samba ukuze kudwetshwe uphayi ophelele. Ungasebenzisa le pharamitha ukudweba izingxenye kuphela zikaphayi noma amashadi egeyiji.

configure.title: Ziba Amanani Angenalutho
configure.description: Amanani angenalutho azozitshwa ukugwema ukudweba izingcezu namalebula angadingekile.

advanced.title: Hlehlisa Idatha
advanced.description: Hlehlisa idatha kuhlanganise amalebula, ukulandelana kochungechunge kanye nawo wonke ama-array edatha yochungechunge.

advanced.title: I-Donut Eqinile
advanced.description: Dweba izingxenye ze-donut njengezimo esikhundleni semigqa.

advanced.title: Isiqondiso Selebula
advanced.description: Dweba izingxenye ze-donut njengezimo esikhundleni semigqa.

advanced.title: Ukususwa Kwelebula
advanced.description: Ukususwa kwendawo yelebula kusuka endaweni ejwayelekile eyingxenye yebanga le-radius. Leli nani lingaba lihle noma libe libi. Amanani amahle azobeka ilebula kude nomkhathi.
